supplements.title: The Diet-Multiple Sclerosis Connection: Oxidative Stress and Emerging Mechanisms.
supplements.summary: Dietary interventions like Mediterranean and ketogenic diets may help reduce oxidative stress in multiple sclerosis by activating the Nrf2 antioxidant pathway.

supplements.title: Bone health in patients with cancer: a SEOM-SEIOMM consensus review of risk factors, assessment strategies, and management approaches.
supplements.summary: Comprehensive review highlights strategies to protect bone health in cancer patients by assessing risks and implementing targeted prevention and treatment approaches.

supplements.title: PINK1 deacetylation by emodin-induced SIRT3 upregulation alleviates acute kidney injury by Inhibition of ferroptosis.
supplements.summary: Emodin reduces acute kidney injury by activating SIRT3, which helps protect mitochondria and prevent cell death through PINK1 regulation.

supplements.title: Orthologue inference-based enzyme mining for diversification of the anti-cancer evodiamine scaffold.
supplements.summary: Researchers discovered four enzymes from rare plants that can selectively modify evodiamine, an anti-cancer compound, potentially improving its therapeutic potential.

supplements.title: KDM6A alternative splicing induced by 25(OH)D inhibits breast cancer cell stemness through repressing TRAP1 transcription.
supplements.summary: 25(OH)D promotes an alternative KDM6A splice variant that reduces breast cancer cell stemness by suppressing TRAP1 transcription.

supplements.title: Vitamin D supplementation before in vitro fertilisation in women with polycystic ovary syndrome: multicentre, double blind, placebo controlled, randomised clinical trial.
supplements.summary: To evaluate whether vitamin D supplementation improves live birth rates in women with polycystic ovary syndrome undergoing in vitro fertilisation.

supplements.title: Dual-phytochemical electrospun PLA-PCL nanofibers loaded with centella asiatica extract and curcumin for sustained anticancer and antimicrobial drug delivery.
supplements.summary: Electrospun nanofibers combining Centella asiatica extract and curcumin demonstrate targeted, sustained anticancer activity against breast cancer cells with reduced toxicity.

supplements.title: Metal-Phenolic Networks-Based Nanozyme Reprograms Tumor Metabolism and Immunosuppressive Microenvironment to Enhance Ferroptosis and Potentiate Cancer Immunotherapy.
supplements.summary: A metal-phenolic nanozyme loaded with multiple compounds reprograms tumor metabolism, induces ferroptosis, and boosts immune response against cancer cells.

supplements.title: Methanol extract of Chenopodium murale L. attenuated TNF-α-mediated oxidative stress and inflammation in murine models.
supplements.summary: Chenopodium murale L. methanol extract reduced inflammation and oxidative stress in arthritis models by suppressing TNF-α and inflammatory markers.

supplements.title: The impact of dietary constituents on inflammation and cognitive function in healthy older Irish adults: A pilot study.
supplements.summary: In healthy older adults, higher BMI, low physical activity, and nutrient deficiencies were associated with increased inflammation and decreased cognitive performance.

supplements.title: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and type 2 diabetes: Pathophysiology, diagnosis, and emerging therapeutic strategies.
supplements.summary: In patients with type 2 diabetes, emerging pharmacotherapies like GLP-1 receptor agonists show promise in treating metabolic liver disease and reducing related health risks.

supplements.title: Integrated hepatic transcriptome and metabolome reveal the mechanisms of Jiangtang Tiaozhi formula on improving glycolipid metabolic disorder.
supplements.summary: Glycolipid metabolic disorder includes a series of chronic diseases that are closely associated with disturbances in both glucose and lipid metabolism.

supplements.title: Taurine suppresses gastric intestinal metaplasia in patient-derived organoids and Atp4a -/- mice.
supplements.summary: Taurine effectively reduced precancerous changes in stomach tissue, offering a potential preventive strategy for gastric cancer development.

supplements.title: Efficacy and safety of integrated Chinese and Western medicine in advanced pancreatic cancer: A double-center retrospective cohort study.
supplements.summary: In advanced pancreatic cancer, combining Chinese and Western medicine showed potential benefits, potentially improving patient outcomes compared to traditional treatment alone.

supplements.title: Clinical efficacy of Fuzheng Jiedu Xiaoyong granules in advanced colorectal cancer (spleen deficiency and stasis toxin syndrome).
supplements.summary: Fuzheng Jiedu Xiaoyong granules improved immune function and reduced side effects in patients with advanced colorectal cancer undergoing chemotherapy.

off_label.title: A machine learning model for optimizing treatment of patients with poorly controlled type 2 diabetes.
off_label.summary: A machine learning model predicts the most effective diabetes medication by analyzing individual patient characteristics to guide personalized treatment selection.

off_label.title: Metal-Phenolic Networks-Based Nanozyme Reprograms Tumor Metabolism and Immunosuppressive Microenvironment to Enhance Ferroptosis and Potentiate Cancer Immunotherapy.
off_label.summary: A metal-phenolic nanozyme loaded with multiple compounds reprograms tumor metabolism, induces ferroptosis, and boosts immune response against cancer cells.

off_label.title: Pan-cancer immunogenomics and structure-guided repurposing identify N-Acetyl-L-carnosine as a PAR2 binding modulator.
off_label.summary: N-Acetyl-L-carnosine was identified as a potential PAR2-binding molecule in head and neck and lung cancers, offering a new approach to modulate tumor immune suppression.

off_label.title: Evocalcet improved the PTH-calcium setpoint and suppressed parathyroid proliferation in mice model of primary hyperparathyroidism.
off_label.summary: Evocalcet reduced parathyroid hormone levels and slowed cell growth in a mouse model of primary hyperparathyroidism by targeting the calcium-sensing receptor.

off_label.title: Insulin Autoimmune Syndrome Associated With Hashimoto Thyroiditis and Nodular Thyroid Disease: Clinical Management With Flash Glucose Monitoring and Prednisolone Therapy.
off_label.summary: In a rare case, prednisolone therapy successfully managed a white woman's insulin autoimmune syndrome associated with Hashimoto's thyroiditis and hypoglycemia.

off_label.title: Hyperactivation of mTORC1 signaling mediates folliculin deficiency-induced pulmonary cyst formation in Birt-Hogg-Dubé syndrome.
off_label.summary: In Birt-Hogg-Dubé syndrome, loss of the FLCN gene in lung mesenchymal cells leads to lung cyst formation through hyperactive mTORC1 signaling.

off_label.title: Cancer-Associated Fibroblasts Promote Imatinib Resistance in Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors through PGK1-Mediated Metabolic Reprogramming.
off_label.summary: Cancer-associated fibroblasts in gastrointestinal stromal tumors promote imatinib resistance by altering cancer cell metabolism through TGFβ1 signaling.

off_label.title: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and type 2 diabetes: Pathophysiology, diagnosis, and emerging therapeutic strategies.
off_label.summary: In patients with type 2 diabetes, emerging pharmacotherapies like GLP-1 receptor agonists show promise in treating metabolic liver disease and reducing related health risks.

off_label.title: Metallic elements and their molecular roles in gastric cancer: Pathogenic mechanisms and therapeutic implications.
off_label.summary: Metallic elements like iron, copper, zinc, and calcium play critical roles in gastric cancer progression through complex molecular mechanisms that influence tumor development and potential treatment strategies.

off_label.title: Exposure to GLP-1RA and risk of structural progression in differentiated thyroid cancer.
off_label.summary: GLP-1 receptor agonists may potentially slow structural progression in patients with well-differentiated thyroid cancer, suggesting a promising new therapeutic approach.

off_label.title: Digoxin attenuates LPS-induced acute lung injury in mice via NF-κB and HIF-1α inhibition.
off_label.summary: Digoxin effectively reduces lung inflammation and injury in mice by inhibiting key inflammatory pathways after lipopolysaccharide-induced acute lung damage.

off_label.title: Mitochondrial oxidants promote platelet activation and thrombotic susceptibility in prediabetes.
off_label.summary: In prediabetes, mitochondrial oxidants increase platelet activation and thrombosis risk, which can be reduced by targeted antioxidant treatments.

off_label.title: Targeting of HSP27 and MMP-2/9 Crosstalk by High-Throughput Drug Repurposing Strategies Identifies Paroxetine as a Potential Candidate in Glioblastoma.
off_label.summary: Paroxetine, an antidepressant, was found to inhibit HSP27 and reduce tumor progression in glioblastoma by disrupting key molecular interactions.

off_label.title: HSP90AB1-Mediated Ubiquitin-Proteasome Degradation of ITGBL1 Promotes Osteosarcoma Progression by Inhibiting Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress-Induced Autophagy.
off_label.summary: In osteosarcoma, HSP90AB1 promotes cancer progression by degrading ITGBL1, a protein that suppresses tumor growth, with ivermectin showing potential as a treatment.

off_label.title: Disseminated Strongyloidiasis Following Chemoradiotherapy for Lung Cancer in a Patient Living in a Non-endemic Area in Japan.
off_label.summary: A lung cancer patient with HTLV-1 developed disseminated strongyloidiasis after chemoradiotherapy, successfully treated with intermittent ivermectin over six months.

biomarkers.title: The Antiparasitic Effects of Nitrate and Lactic Acid on Sarcocystis Bradyzoites in Meat: Enhancing Food Safety.
biomarkers.summary: Lactic acid and nitrate effectively kill Sarcocystis bradyzoites in sheep meat, with lactic acid showing superior parasite elimination at lower concentrations.

biomarkers.title: The Diet-Multiple Sclerosis Connection: Oxidative Stress and Emerging Mechanisms.
biomarkers.summary: Dietary interventions like Mediterranean and ketogenic diets may help reduce oxidative stress in multiple sclerosis by activating the Nrf2 antioxidant pathway.

biomarkers.title: Anti-apoptotic BCL-2 binds to all three IP3R isoforms, thereby limiting the Ca2+-flux properties of IP3R homo-tetramers.
biomarkers.summary: BCL-2 protein universally inhibits calcium signaling across all three IP3R receptor isoforms, potentially impacting cancer cell survival mechanisms.

biomarkers.title: Ten-year costs of cardiovascular disease in genetically verified familial hypercholesterolaemia compared with age- and sex-matched controls.
biomarkers.summary: Available data on economic consequences of carrying an inherited familial hypercholesterolaemia (FH) genetic variant are sparse.

biomarkers.summary: Comprehensive review highlights strategies to protect bone health in cancer patients by assessing risks and implementing targeted prevention and treatment approaches.

biomarkers.title: TFAP2C protects against ferroptosis in ovarian cancer through the KEAP1-NRF2 axis by recruiting HDAC1/2.
biomarkers.summary: In ovarian cancer, TFAP2C protects cancer cells from ferroptosis by stabilizing NRF2 and suppressing KEAP1, thereby enhancing cellular antioxidant defenses.

biomarkers.title: Transient telomere uncapping triggers telomeric and subtelomeric rearrangements.
biomarkers.summary: Transient telomere uncapping in yeast rapidly triggers extensive chromosome rearrangements and telomere elongation through homologous recombination mechanisms.

biomarkers.title: ΔNp63α drives serine synthesis to promote carboplatin resistance in NSCLC.
biomarkers.summary: In lung squamous cell carcinoma, the ΔNp63α protein drives serine metabolism, enabling cancer cells to resist carboplatin chemotherapy by supporting DNA repair and antioxidant defenses.

biomarkers.title: Galloyl-Mediated Antigen Capture Coupled with Hypoxia-Responsive Reprogramming Drives Potent Photoimmunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: A nanoparticle vaccine capturing tumor antigens and using photodynamic therapy helps activate immune responses against melanoma, suppressing both local and distant tumors.

biomarkers.summary: Electrospun nanofibers combining Centella asiatica extract and curcumin demonstrate targeted, sustained anticancer activity against breast cancer cells with reduced toxicity.

biomarkers.title: IMS-IMWG 2025 consensus genomic staging predicts outcomes with daratumumab-based quadruplet regimens for NDMM.
biomarkers.summary: A new genomic staging system for multiple myeloma effectively predicts patient progression-free survival when using daratumumab-based quadruplet treatment.

trials.summary: Two modified peptides targeting gastrin-releasing peptide receptor showed promising potential for PET imaging and targeted radionuclide therapy of cancer.

trials.title: Anti-myeloma activity of the CXCR4 antagonist WZ811.
trials.summary: In multiple myeloma, the CXCR4 antagonist WZ811 effectively reduced tumor burden, induced cancer cell death, and enhanced survival by targeting malignant plasma cells.

trials.title: Palladium-catalysed synthesis of small-molecule epigenetic inhibitors as anticancer therapeutics.
trials.summary: Palladium-catalyzed chemical reactions enable precise synthesis of small-molecule compounds that could potentially inhibit cancer cell growth by targeting epigenetic mechanisms.
